stdout:
Usage: skilllint docs verify [OPTIONS] {file_path}

  Verify a cached file against its .meta.json sidecar.
  
  Exits 0 when the file is intact, 1 otherwise.
  
  Exit status:
      1 when MODIFIED or UNVERIFIABLE.

Arguments:
  file_path  Path to the cached markdown file to verify against its sidecar.  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
